name: Town Square
blurb: Where every cat arrives. The café and the shop are here.

name: Garden Courtyard
blurb: Flower beds and a quiet bench.

name: Pear Orchard
blurb: Pears to pick, shade to nap in.

name: Cat Homes Lane
blurb: A lane of little houses, one for each cat.

name: Lighthouse Point
blurb: A tall light over the waves.

name: Sunny Cove
blurb: A boardwalk, a pond and a boat shed.

name: Scratching Peaks
blurb: Climb the scratching posts to the top.

name: Market Row
blurb: Stalls of hats, toys and treats.

name: Old Mill
blurb: Fresh bread from the mill bakery.

name: Whisker Woods
blurb: Wild friends live among the trees.

name: Nap Hollow
blurb: A warm hollow where kittens sleep.

name: Dojo Courtyard
blurb: A training yard behind a waterfall. The dojo hall is through the door.

name: Ice Rink
blurb: Skates in winter, a soccer pitch the rest of the year.

name: Mine Shack
blurb: A little hut at the mouth of the old tunnels.
